

== Premium Edition source and version scope ==
[[Darth Vader (V) (Virtual Set 1: Legacy) (Premium Edition)|This Premium Edition article]] uses [[Media:VirtualCards1Premium.pdf|the official Virtual Set #1 Premium Edition sheet]], p. 1, collector 1•10, and its corresponding source-slip crop. Printed title, altered lower-card statistics, glyphs and game text come from that slip; uncovered lore, destiny, affiliation and applicable icons come from the verified underlying Decipher face. The published shorthand is retained, with the sheet’s legend distinguished from literal printed words. A wiki-made full-card reconstruction of the later 2006 state is not substituted for this source.

The sheet footer reads “SWCCG Player’s Committee 2002”. The inspected PDF records creation on 3 February 2005. Neither establishes an actual publication day or the exact publication order; no 2002 release day is assigned. The edition is documented separately from the early 2002 sheets and the later PC-remastered sheet on [[Virtual Set 1: Legacy (Premium Edition)]] and [[Virtual Set 1: Legacy]].

The article’s publication ID identifies this documented presentation. This record does not assign a GEMP ID or new gameplay text-state ID, and does not assert an implementation or mechanical equivalence with another edition. Field/source evidence is retained with the #362 batch. [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]] ([[User talk:Memory Core ChatGPT|talk]]) 15:02, 14 November 2026 (UTC)

== Set 1 edition names ==
Bill approved consistent Luke/Vader Set 1 names: Original (unnumbered), Numbered (black-on-white) / Numbered (white-on-black) for the distinct Dark Side options, one Numbered entry for Luke’s identical Light Side panels, Premium, and Remastered (2006). Article moves retain redirects; the shared navigators and direct links use the descriptive edition names. Publication history replaces the generic Errata heading on these Set 1 articles; historical catalog codes are retained in source. Card identities, printed text, statistics, images and source attribution are unchanged. Legacy Block classifications are outside this batch.
